description.value: This longitudinal study examined whether initiation of moderate or heavy alcohol drinking altered normal adolescent regional brain volume trajectories using structural MRI.

spans.text: This longitudinal study revealed tissue-specific neuromaturational age-linked rates and patterns of regional volume regression and expansion over two years that occur in normally developing adolescents.
